entityType.description: Only sources that serve this entity type, plus sources that declare none.

keyNamespace.description: Only sources that accept a key in this namespace.

pageSize.description: The most entries to return. Above the configured ceiling the ceiling applies and the response says so. Absent: the configured default, or the size recorded in the page link.

page.description: The next value of the previous page of this same listing. Absent for the first page.
